title: What's New — Evidence & Accuracy
summary: PulseGuard now correlates stability evidence to the exact test window, adds a pinned hardware-sensor provider path, deeper storage/network/battery/latency diagnostics, repair verification states, and stronger driver provenance.

items.heading: Evidence-first hardware telemetry
items.detail: PulseGuard can automatically acquire and SHA-256 verify the pinned LibreHardwareMonitor v0.9.6 provider, while retaining native fallbacks and never guessing unavailable sensors.

items.heading: Stability events are time-windowed
items.detail: New WHEA and storage events are correlated to the exact 3-minute test window and kept separate from historical Windows event history.

items.heading: Repairs now carry verification state
items.detail: Repair evidence uses stable keys and explicit VERIFIED_FIXED, IMPROVED, NOT_FIXED, REBOOT_REQUIRED, UNVERIFIED, or NO_CHANGE_NEEDED outcomes instead of treating command completion as proof.

items.heading: Deeper PC diagnostics
items.detail: Storage reliability, scheduling pressure, network path health, battery health, hardware inventory and truthful GPU-memory capability evidence are included without fake PASS states.

items.heading: Driver provenance hardened
items.detail: Dynamic OEM discovery records source/parser/package/hardware-match provenance while retaining official-host, signature, hardware-ID, no-downgrade, backup and verification safety gates. BIOS auto-flashing remains blocked.
